Fixes gossip neighbours flapping in networks of more than 6 nodes. Each node now keeps up to 32 active and 64 passive gossip neighbours (it was 5), so neighbours stop being dropped and re-added over and over.

This is a plain upgrade: re-run the installer (or build the `v0.1.1` tag). No reset, no rejoin. Nodes still on v0.1.0 keep talking to it, but they keep churning their gossip neighbours until they upgrade.

Install and compatibility are the same as in [v0.1.0](https://github.com/SauersML/islandmail/releases/tag/v0.1.0).
